-t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n531\t    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n532\t    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n533\t    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n534\t    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n535\t\n536\t    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n542\t};\n543\t\n544\t// ============================================================================\n545\t// Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549\t                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550\t    // Generate mesh\n551\t    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n552\t    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n566\t        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n567\t    }\n568\t\n569\t    // Initialize reflectivity\n570\t    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n571\t\n572\t    // Initialize matrices\n573\t    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n574\t    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n575\t    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n576\t    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n577\t    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t            if (i == j) continue;\n598\t            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n599\t                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n600\t        }\n601\t        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608\t    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n609\t\n610\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n611\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n612\t            if (i == j) continue;\n613\t            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n614\t                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n615\t        }\n616\t    }\n617\t}\n618\t\n619\t// ============================================================================\n620\t// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634\t\n635\t                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n636\t                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n637\t\n638\t                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n639\t                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n640\t\n641\t                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n642\t                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n647\t                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n648\t            }\n649\t\n650\t            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// ============================================================================\n661\t// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n662\t// ============================================================================\n663\t\n664\tvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n665\t    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n666\t\n667\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n668\t        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n669\t        int bestT = 0;\n670\t\n671\t        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n672\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n673\t            val_t sum = ZERO;\n674\t\n675\t            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n676\t                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n677\t                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];\n678\t                sum += pS * pB;\n679\t            }\n680\t\n681\t            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n682\t                maxCorr = sum;\n683\t                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n684\t            }\n685\t        }\n686\t\n687\t        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n688\t    }\n689\t}\n690\t\n691\t// ============================================================================\n692\t// Validation\n693\t// ============================================================================\n694\t\n695\tbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n696\t    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n697\t\n698\t    // Check that distances are non-negative\n699\t    bool allNonNegative = true;\n700\t    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n701\t    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n702\t    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n703\t    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n704\t\n705\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n706\t        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n707\t        if (d < 0) {\n708\t            allNonNegative = false;\n709\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n710\t        }\n711\t        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n712\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n713\t            return false;\n714\t        }\n715\t        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n716\t        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n717\t        sumDist += d;\n718\t        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n719\t    }\n720\t\n721\t    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n722\t    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n723\t    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n724\t\n725\t    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n726\t    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n727\t    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n728\t        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n729\t    }\n730\t\n731\t    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n732\t    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n733\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n734\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n735\t            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n736\t                receivedEnergy++;\n737\t                break;\n738\t            }\n739\t        }\n740\t    }\n741\t\n742\t    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n743\t\n744\t    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n745\t        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n746\t        return false;\n747\t    }\n748\t\n749\t    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n750\t    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n751\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n752\t        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n753\t    }\n754\t    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n755\t           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n756\t           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n757\t\n758\t    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n759\t        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n760\t        return false;\n761\t    }\n762\t\n763\t    if (!allNonNegative) {\n764\t        return false;\n765\t    }\n766\t\n767\t    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n768\t    return true;\n769\t}\n770\t\n771\t// ============================================================================\n772\t// Hash for Verification\n773\t// ============================================================================\n774\t\n775\tuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n776\t    uint64_t hash = 0;\n777\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n778\t        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n779\t        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n780\t    }\n781\t    return hash;\n782\t}\n783\t\n784\t// ============================================================================\n785\t// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n786\t// ============================================================================\n787\t\n788\tint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n789\t    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n790\t    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n791\t    int subdivisions = 0;\n792\t    int triangles = 20;\n793\t    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n794\t        subdivisions++;\n795\t        triangles *= 4;\n796\t    }\n797\t    return subdivisions;\n798\t}\n799\t\n800\t// ============================================================================\n801\t// Main\n802\t// ============================================================================\n803\t\n804\tvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n805\t    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n806\t    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n807\t    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n808\t    printf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n809\t    printf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n810\t    printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n811\t    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n812\t    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n813\t    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n814\t    printf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n815\t    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n816\t}\n817\t\n818\tint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n819\t    int targetTriangles = 320;\n820\t    int timesteps = 50;\n821\t    int sourceIdx = 0;\n822\t    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n823\t    bool validate = false;\n824\t    bool printResults = false;\n825\t\n826\t    // Parse command line arguments\n827\t    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n828\t        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n829\t            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n830\t        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n831\t            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n832\t        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n833\t            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n834\t        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == edges\n    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n\n    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n        return boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n    };\n\n    Vec3        minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Collect all indices\n        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n\n        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n    }\n\nprivate:\n    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n        minBound = nodeMin;\n        maxBound = nodeMax;\n        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n\n        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z :   std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm, device)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float rayTriangleIntersectDev(float3 orig, float3 dir,\n                                                         float3 v0, float3 v1, float3 v2) {\n    constexpr float MAXV = 3.402823466e+38f;\n    float3 e1 = f3sub(v1, v0);\n    float3 e2 = f3sub(v2, v0);\n    float3 pvec = f3cross(dir, e2);\n    float det = f3dot(e1, pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return MAXV;\n\n    float invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    float3 tvec = f3sub(orig, v0);\n    float u = f3dot(tvec, pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return MAXV;\n\n    float3 qvec = f3cross(tvec, e1);\n    float v = f3dot(dir, qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return MAXV;\n\n    return f3dot(e2, qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (flattened-octree traversal, device)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray segment intersects a node's bounding box\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsBoxDev(const FlatOctreeNode& n,\n                                                    float3 p1, float3 p2) {\n    float3 d = f3scale(f3sub(p2, p1), 0.5f);\n    float3 c = f3sub(f3add(p1, d), make_float3(n.cx, n.cy, n.cz));\n    float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > n.hx + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > n.hy + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > n.hz + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > n.hy * ad.z + n.hz * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > n.hz * ad.x + n.hx * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > n.hx * ad.y + n.hy * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nconstexpr int OCTREE_STACK_SIZE = 64;\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n__device__ bool isRayBlockedDev(float3 from, float3 to,\n                                const FlatOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                                const int* __restrict__ nodeTriIndices,\n                                const float3* __restrict__ triA,\n                                const float3* __restrict__ triB,\n                                const float3* __restrict__ triC,\n                                int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx) {\n    float3 dir = f3sub(to, from);\n    float rayLen = f3norm(dir);\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    float3 dirNorm = f3scale(dir, 1.0f / rayLen);\n\n    int stack[OCTREE_STACK_SIZE];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;  // root is visited without a box test (as in applyToTris)\n\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const FlatOctreeNode n = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n\n        if (n.triCount > 0) {\n            // Leaf: test contained triangles\n            for (int k = 0; k < n.triCount; ++k) {\n                int idx = nodeTriIndices[n.triStart + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n\n                float dist = rayTriangleIntersectDev(from, dirNorm,\n                                                     triA[idx], triB[idx], triC[idx]);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n                    return true;  // Ray is blocked\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Internal node: descend into children overlapping the ray\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                int ch = n.child[c];\n                if (ch >= 0 && rayIntersectsBoxDev(nodes[ch], from, to)) {\n                    stack[sp++] = ch;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij) - CUDA kernel over all owned (i, j) pairs\n// ============================================================================\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float cosPhiDev(float3 v, float3 normal) {\n    float vNorm = f3norm(v);\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return 0.0f;\n    return fmaxf(0.0f, f3dot(v, normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n__global__ void formFactorKernel(int numTriangles, int rowStart, int rowsLocal,\n                                 const float3* __restrict__ triA,\n                                 const float3* __restrict__ triB,\n                                 const float3* __restrict__ triC,\n                                 const float3* __restrict__ triN,\n                                 const FlatOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                                 const int* __restrict__ nodeTriIndices,\n                                 float* __restrict__ kijLocal) {\n    long long idx = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    long long total = static_cast<long long>(rowsLocal) * numTriangles;\n    if (idx >= total) return;\n\n    int iLocal = static_cast<int>(idx / numTriangles);\n    int j = static_cast<int>(idx % numTriangles);\n    int i = rowStart + iLocal;\n\n    float result = 0.0f;\n    // Cull the diagonal and triangles facing the same direction\n    if (i != j && f3dot(triN[i], triN[j]) <= 0.99f) {\n        float3 aI = triA[i], bI = triB[i], cI = triC[i], nI = triN[i];\n        float3 aJ = triA[j], bJ = triB[j], cJ = triC[j], nJ = triN[j];\n\n        // Deterministic per-pair RNG stream (independent of parallel layout)\n        uint64_t rngState = (static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles + j)\n                            * 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL + 42ULL;\n\n        float kij = 0.0f;\n        for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n            float u1 = rngUniform(rngState);\n            float v1 = rngUniform(rngState);\n            float u2 = rngUniform(rngState);\n            float v2 = rngUniform(rngState);\n            float3 pI = randomPointInTriangleDev(aI, bI, cI, u1, v1);\n            float3 pJ = randomPointInTriangleDev(aJ, bJ, cJ, u2, v2);\n\n            if (isRayBlockedDev(pI, pJ, nodes, nodeTriIndices, triA, triB, triC, i, j)) continue;\n\n            float3 v = f3sub(pJ, pI);\n            float distSqr = f3dot(v, v);\n            if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n            float cosPhiI = cosPhiDev(v, nI);\n            float cosPhiJ = cosPhiDev(f3neg(v), nJ);\n\n            if (cosPhiI <= 0.0f || cosPhiJ <= 0.0f) continue;\n\n            kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n        }\n        result = kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n    }\n\n    kijLocal[idx] = result;\n}\n\n// Count non-zero form factors (for validation) without a host-side copy\n__global__ void countNonZeroKernel(const float* __restrict__ data, long long n,\n                                   unsigned long long* __restrict__ count) {\n    long long idx = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    long long stride = static_cast<long long>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x;\n    unsigned long long local = 0;\n    for (long long k = idx; k < n; k += stride) {\n        if (data[k] > EPSILON) ++local;\n    }\n    if (local) atomicAdd(count, local);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation) - one block per owned row per timestep\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr int SIM_BLOCK_SIZE = 256;\n\n__global__ void simulationStepKernel(int numTriangles, int rowStart, int t,\n                                     const float* __restrict__ kijLocal,\n                                     const int* __restrict__ tauLocal,\n                                     const float* __restrict__ areas,\n                                     const float* __restrict__ rho,\n                                     const float* __restrict__ radE,\n                                     float* __restrict__ radB) {\n    int iLocal = blockIdx.x;\n    int i = rowStart + iLocal;\n    const float* kRow = kijLocal + static_cast<size_t>(iLocal) * numTriangles;\n    const int* tauRow = tauLocal + static_cast<size_t>(iLocal) * numTriangles;\n\n    float sumB = 0.0f;\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {\n        if (j == i) continue;\n\n        int tauij = tauRow[j];\n        // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n        if (t < tauij) continue;\n\n        float kij = kRow[j];\n        if (kij <= 0.0f) continue;\n\n        // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n        float radJ = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - tauij) * numTriangles + j];\n        if (radJ <= 0.0f) continue;\n\n        // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n        sumB += fminf(kij * areas[j], 1.0f) * radJ;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ float sdata[SIM_BLOCK_SIZE];\n    sdata[threadIdx.x] = sumB;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n        if (threadIdx.x < s) sdata[threadIdx.x] += sdata[threadIdx.x + s];\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        size_t out = static_cast<size_t>(t) * numTriangles + i;\n        // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n        radB[out] = rho[i] * sdata[0] + radE[out];\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation) - one thread per owned triangle\n// ============================================================================\n\n__global__ void distanceKernel(int numTriangles, int numTimesteps,\n                               int rowStart, int rowsLocal,\n                               const float* __restrict__ radB,\n                               const float* __restrict__ srcSeries,\n                               float* __restrict__ distLocal) {\n    int iLocal = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (iLocal >= rowsLocal) return;\n    int i = rowStart + iLocal;\n\n    float maxCorr = 0.0f;\n    int bestT = 0;\n\n    // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n    for (int t = 0; t < numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        float sum = 0.0f;\n        for (int tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n            float pB = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt) * numTriangles + i];\n            float pS = srcSeries[tt - t];\n            sum += pS * pB;\n        }\n        if (sum > maxCorr) {\n            maxCorr = sum;\n            bestT = t;\n        }\n    }\n\n    distLocal[iLocal] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<float>(bestT);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<int> tauLocal;      // Time delays (owned rows x N, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // MPI row decomposition of the triangle set\n    int mpiRank = 0, mpiSize = 1;\n    int rowStart = 0, rowsLocal = 0;\n    std::vector<int> allCounts, allDispls;  // Allgatherv layout per rank\n\n    // Device-resident data (per rank, on its assigned GPU)\n    float3* dTriA = nullptr;\n    float3* dTriB = nullptr;\n    float3* dTriC = nullptr;\n    float3* dTriN = nullptr;\n    FlatOctreeNode* dNodes = nullptr;\n    int* dNodeTris = nullptr;\n    float* dAreas = nullptr;\n    float* dRho = nullptr;\n    float* dKijLocal = nullptr;\n    int* dTauLocal = nullptr;\n    float* dRadE = nullptr;\n    float* dRadB = nullptr;\n\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh (identically on every rank; the mesh is deterministic)\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    if (state.mpiRank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n    }\n\n    // Row decomposition across MPI ranks\n    int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    state.allCounts.resize(state.mpiSize);\n    state.allDispls.resize(state.mpiSize);\n    for (int r = 0; r < state.mpiSize; ++r) {\n        int base = n / state.mpiSize;\n        int rem = n % state.mpiSize;\n        state.allCounts[r] = base + (r < rem ? 1 : 0);\n        state.allDispls[r] = r * base + std::min(r, rem);\n    }\n    state.rowStart = state.allDispls[state.mpiRank];\n    state.rowsLocal = state.allCounts[state.mpiRank];\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    if (state.mpiRank == 0) printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas and reflectivity\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (long long i = 0; i < static_cast<long long>(state.numTriangles); ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices (Kij/Tau hold only the rows owned by this rank)\n    state.tauLocal.resize(static_cast<size_t>(state.rowsLocal) * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// Select this rank's GPU (round-robin over the GPUs of its node) and upload\n// all static simulation data.\nvoid initializeDevice(SimulationState& state) {\n    // Determine node-local rank for GPU assignment\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, state.mpiRank,\n                        MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm);\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount == 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA devices available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % deviceCount));\n\n    size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    size_t t = state.numTimesteps;\n    size_t localMat = static_cast<size_t>(state.rowsLocal) * n;\n\n    // Triangle geometry as structure-of-arrays\n    std::vector<float3> hA(n), hB(n), hC(n), hN(n);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (long long i = 0; i < static_cast<long long>(n); ++i) {\n        const Triangle& tri = state.triangles[i];\n        hA[i] = make_float3(tri.a.x, tri.a.y, tri.a.z);\n        hB[i] = make_float3(tri.b.x, tri.b.y, tri.b.z);\n        hC[i] = make_float3(tri.c.x, tri.c.y, tri.c.z);\n        Vec3 nm = tri.normal();\n        hN[i] = make_float3(nm.x, nm.y, nm.z);\n    }\n\n    // Flatten the octree for GPU traversal\n    std::vector<FlatOctreeNode> flatNodes;\n    std::vector<int> flatTris;\n    flattenOctree(state.octree, flatNodes, flatTris);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTriA, n * sizeof(float3)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTriB, n * sizeof(float3)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTriC, n * sizeof(float3)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTriN, n * sizeof(float3)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dNodes, flatNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dNodeTris, std::max<size_t>(1, flatTris.size()) * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dAreas, n * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dRho, n * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dKijLocal, std::max<size_t>(1, localMat) * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTauLocal, std::max<size_t>(1, localMat) * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dRadE, t * n * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dRadB, t * n * sizeof(float)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriA, hA.data(), n * sizeof(float3), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriB, hB.data(), n * sizeof(float3), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriC, hC.data(), n * sizeof(float3), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriN, hN.data(), n * sizeof(float3), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNodes, flatNodes.data(),\n                          flatNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (!flatTris.empty()) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNodeTris, flatTris.data(),\n                              flatTris.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dAreas, state.areas.data(), n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRho, state.rho.data(), n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRadE, state.radE.data(), t * n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.dRadB, 0, t * n * sizeof(float)));\n}\n\nvoid freeDevice(SimulationState& state) {\n    cudaFree(state.dTriA);\n    cudaFree(state.dTriB);\n    cudaFree(state.dTriC);\n    cudaFree(state.dTriN);\n    cudaFree(state.dNodes);\n    cudaFree(state.dNodeTris);\n    cudaFree(state.dAreas);\n    cudaFree(state.dRho);\n    cudaFree(state.dKijLocal);\n    cudaFree(state.dTauLocal);\n    cudaFree(state.dRadE);\n    cudaFree(state.dRadB);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (state.mpiRank == 0) printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij) on GPU...\\n\");\n\n    long long total = static_cast<long long>(state.rowsLocal) * state.numTriangles;\n    if (total > 0) {\n        int blockSize = 128;\n        long long numBlocks = (total + blockSize - 1) / blockSize;\n        formFactorKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned>(numBlocks), blockSize>>>(\n            static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles), state.rowStart, state.rowsLocal,\n            state.dTriA, state.dTriB, state.dTriC, state.dTriN,\n            state.dNodes, state.dNodeTris, state.dKijLocal);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (state.mpiRank == 0) printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau) with OpenMP...\\n\");\n\n    size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (long long iLocal = 0; iLocal < state.rowsLocal; ++iLocal) {\n        size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(state.rowStart + iLocal);\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tauLocal[static_cast<size_t>(iLocal) * n + j] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Upload the owned Tau block for the GPU propagation kernels\n    size_t localMat = static_cast<size_t>(state.rowsLocal) * n;\n    if (localMat > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTauLocal, state.tauLocal.data(),\n                              localMat * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (state.mpiRank == 0) printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        // Each rank computes radB[t][i] for its owned rows on the GPU. The\n        // dependency radB[t - tau][j] with tau >= 1 keeps timesteps sequential.\n        if (state.rowsLocal > 0) {\n            simulationStepKernel<<<state.rowsLocal, SIM_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(\n                n, state.rowStart, static_cast<int>(t),\n                state.dKijLocal, state.dTauLocal, state.dAreas, state.dRho,\n                state.dRadE, state.dRadB);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n            // Fetch the owned slice of this timestep's radiosity\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.radB.data() + state.idxTN(t, state.rowStart),\n                                  state.dRadB + state.idxTN(t, state.rowStart),\n                                  state.rowsLocal * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        // Exchange this timestep's radiosity across all ranks\n        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL,\n                       state.radB.data() + state.idxTN(t, 0),\n                       state.allCounts.data(), state.allDispls.data(), MPI_FLOAT,\n                       MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        // Push the assembled full timestep back to the device\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRadB + state.idxTN(t, 0),\n                              state.radB.data() + state.idxTN(t, 0),\n                              n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        if (state.mpiRank == 0 && ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps)) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (state.mpiRank == 0) printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    // Radiosity time series of the source triangle (full radB is on every rank)\n    std::vector<float> srcSeries(T);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (long long tt = 0; tt < static_cast<long long>(T); ++tt) {\n        srcSeries[tt] = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, state.sourceIndex)];\n    }\n\n    float* dSrc = nullptr;\n    float* dDist = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dSrc, T * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dDist, std::max(1, state.rowsLocal) * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dSrc, srcSeries.data(), T * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    if (state.rowsLocal > 0) {\n        int blockSize = 128;\n        int numBlocks = (state.rowsLocal + blockSize - 1) / blockSize;\n        distanceKernel<<<numBlocks, blockSize>>>(\n            static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles), static_cast<int>(T),\n            state.rowStart, state.rowsLocal, state.dRadB, dSrc, dDist);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.distances.data() + state.rowStart, dDist,\n                              state.rowsLocal * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dSrc));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dDist));\n\n    // Assemble the full distance vector on every rank\n {\n                if (i == j) continue;\n\n                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n\n                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n            }\n\n            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n        }\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];\n                sum += pS * pB;\n            }\n\n            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n                maxCorr = sum;\n                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n            }\n        }\n\n        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation ++i) {\n        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n    }\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n    };\n\n    Vec3 std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n\n    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n\n    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n        allTriangles = triangles) {\n            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Collect all indices\n        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n\n        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n    }\n\nprivate:\n    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CefXfXwgzS51CAk81mSVo","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Done. The roomsim benchmark is now a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program, verified correct and dramatically faster.\n\n## What was changed\n\n**`roomsim/roomsim.cpp`** (executable name and CLI unchanged):\n- **CUDA** handles all three dominant computations on the GPU: the Monte Carlo form-factor estimation (`formFactorKernel`, one thread per triangle pair running octree-accelerated visibility ray tracing — the octree is built on the host and flattened into linear arrays for stack-based device traversal), the per-timestep radiosity propagation (`simulationStepKernel`, one block per owned row with a shared-memory reduction over all source triangles), and the distance cross-correlation (`distanceKernel`).\n- **MPI** row-decomposes the Kij/Tau matrices across ranks; each rank stores only its block and drives its own GPU (round-robin over node-local GPUs via `MPI_Comm_split_type`, so 4 ranks use all 4 RTX 3090s). Timesteps stay sequential (tau ≥ 1 dependency), with each step's radiosity exchanged via an in-place `MPI_Allgatherv`; distances are gathered the same way at the end.\n- **OpenMP** parallelizes the CPU-side O(N²) time-delay (Tau) computation plus host initialization and validation loops.\n- The one semantic change: the original consumed a single sequential mt19937 stream across all pairs, which cannot be reproduced in parallel. The form-factor sampling now uses a deterministic counter-based splitmix64 generator seeded per (pair, ray) — statistically equivalent uniform sampling, with the bonus that results are **bit-identical regardless of rank count** (verified: 1, 2, and 4 ranks produce identical output).\n\n**`roomsim/CMakeLists.txt`**: compiles the source as CUDA (`set_source_files_properties(... LANGUAGE CUDA)`, arch `native`), links `CUDA::cudart`, `MPI::MPI_CXX`, `OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX`; no new dependencies or files.\n\n## Verification and performance (4× RTX 3090, OpenMPI)\n\n| Case | Sequential | Parallel (4 ranks) | Speedup | Results |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| n=320, t=50 | 1.47 s | 34 ms | ~43× | identical incl. hash, validation PASSED |\n| n=1280, t=100 | 26.7 s | 60 ms | ~445× | sum differs 0.0045% (MC variation), PASSED |\n| n=5120, t=50 | 468 s | 310 ms | **~1510×** | sum/min/max/samples all identical, PASSED |\n| n=20480, t=100 | (not run) | 5.2 s | — | validation PASSED |\n\nMPI scaling at n=5120 is 3.3× from 1→4 ranks (1017 ms → 310 ms). The tiny numeric differences at some sizes come only from the reworked Monte Carlo sampling; since distances are quantized to half-wavespeed bins, most outputs match the sequential code exactly."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":538,"cache_read_input_tokens":79290,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":538},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"41f8a24a-13cd-40e3-8673-0b014b2eacdb","uuid":"fe8b2201-e460-47e0-bd31-26b26bd3b25b","timestamp":"2026-09-03T00:05:56.303Z","request_id":"req_011CefXfVzcd9czYFyjs6DpF"}

LANGUAGE CUDA)`, arch `native`), links `CUDA::cudart`, `MPI::MPI_CXX`, `OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX`; no new dependencies or files.\n\n## Verification and performance (4× RTX 3090, OpenMPI)\n\n| Case | Sequential | Parallel (4 ranks) | Speedup | Results |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| n=320, t=50 | 1.47 s | 34 ms | ~43× | identical incl. hash, validation PASSED |\n| n=1280, t=100 | 26.7 s | 60 ms | ~445× | sum differs 0.0045% (MC variation), PASSED |\n| n=5120, t=50 | 468 s | 310 ms | **~1510×** | sum/min/max/samples all identical, PASSED |\n| n=20480, t=100 | (not run) | 5.2 s | — | validation PASSED |\n\nMPI scaling at n=5120 is 3.3× from 1→4 ranks (1017 ms → 310 ms).
